##### Project general facts

99 Parkplace is a collection of ninety-nine residences designed to reflect sophistication and functionality, located in the vibrant community. From the beautiful elevation to the aesthetic interiors and expertly curated amenities, everything at 99 Parkplace exudes exclusivity and charm. Offering studios, one-bedroom, one-bedroom with study, and two-bedroom with study apartments, this development is a statement about taste, appreciation for the finer things, and a desire for a life that is exquisite, exceptional, and elite.

Residents enjoy amenities tailored to elevate the living experience, including a 24/7 concierge, wellness centre, smart-home automation, lobby lounge, and business center. The leisure deck features a beach-style swimming pool, kids water park, and jacuzzi, while the sky deck offers a rooftop cinema, plunge pool, kids play area, and BBQ area. Every level of 99 Parkplace offers a unique experience, from moments of solitude to the joy of togetherness.

Every residence at 99 Parkplace features unique elements such as iconic floor-to-ceiling tiles, an island countertop table in the kitchen, and stylish European-branded appliances. Spacious layouts include walk-in wardrobes, floor-to-ceiling windows, full balcony access, and a smart home system. The interiors are designed to feel like the perfect fit from the first moment, with every detail curated to ensure warmth, comfort, and undeniable connection.
 
##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, this exceptional location offers the perfect balance of convenience and connectivity. Circle Mall, Springs Souk, Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Miracle Garden, Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, and Jebel Ali Race Course are all within easy reach, while international schools, nurseries, and healthcare facilities are just minutes away.

The location is distinguished by its excellent connectivity to major transport hubs, with Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport both accessible within a short drive. The community's central position ensures that residents enjoy a lifestyle of ease and accessibility.

For those seeking a residence that embodies sophisticated living, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, family-friendly environment, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can live beyond expectations — refined, connected and effortlessly inspiring.
